title: feat(electron): add snapshot history for draft restore and reuse

issue_comments.body:
### Code review

Overall direction looks good — snapshot store is pure and tested, IPC follows the existing bridge pattern, OpenSpec proposal is structured. A few real implementation issues worth fixing (lower-confidence individually, but together they affect user-visible correctness):

- **`state.error` is being used as a success-toast channel.** `renderStatus` formats `state.error` as `— Error: <msg>`, so the snapshot success messages ("Snapshot created", "Restored snapshot...", "Reused snapshot...") will render to the user as errors. Either route success messages through a new `state.statusMessage` field, or add a transient-success channel.

https://github.com/floatboatai/Nexus-Editor/blob/50364039ae70b756cdf2d54e04f753ca3b385a67/apps/electron-demo/src/renderer/app.ts#L265-L310

- **`snapshots.json` is rewritten non-atomically with no size cap.** Every `snapshot:create` does `readSnapshotStore` → `addSnapshot` → full `writeFile` rewrite, and there's no validation on `input.content` size. A crash mid-write corrupts the entire history store across all documents, and a large note × 20 retention × N docs grows the JSON quickly. Two suggestions: (1) write to `snapshots.json.tmp` then `rename` for atomicity, (2) reject `content` above a configurable byte cap.

https://github.com/floatboatai/Nexus-Editor/blob/50364039ae70b756cdf2d54e04f753ca3b385a67/apps/electron-demo/electron/snapshots.ts#L1-L111

- **`parseSnapshotStore` silently returns an empty store on parse failure.** A single bad write erases the visible history with no log and no `.bak`. At minimum log the parse error; ideally rename the corrupt file to `snapshots.json.corrupt-<ts>` before returning empty so users can recover.

- **`normalizeDocKey` only swaps backslashes.** It doesn't `path.resolve`, lower-case (macOS/Windows are case-insensitive), or dereference symlinks — opening the same file via `./notes/foo.md` vs `notes/foo.md` vs an absolute path produces three separate snapshot histories. design.md acknowledges "unsaved-document identity is coarse" but doesn't acknowledge this for saved files.

- **`reuseSnapshot` doesn't call `confirmDiscardIfDirty`** while `restoreSnapshot` does. Clicking Reuse with unsaved changes silently discards them. If the divergence is intentional ("reuse means new draft, don't prompt"), worth a spec scenario; otherwise add the guard.

- **Renderer imports `import type { SnapshotEntry } from "../../electron/snapshots"`.** Type-only is safe today, but it's the only place renderer reaches across the main/renderer boundary into `electron/`, and design.md proposed types live in `bridge.d.ts` (which already redeclares `SnapshotEntry`). Pick one source of truth — the cross-boundary import is fragile to future tsconfig/path changes.

- **Merge conflict risk with PR #15.** Both PRs modify `electron/main.ts`, `renderer/app.ts`, and `renderer/state.ts`. Whichever lands second will need a rebase.

- (CLAUDE.md note) The OpenSpec proposal is included — that's good.
